name: Unidentified hubdroid
description: A hubdroid led a squad aboard the Galactic Empire prison Accresker Jail. The hubdroid was sabotaged by Chelli Lona Aphra during an attack on an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate, causing it to explode, killing all the members of its squad aside from Aphra and Lopset Yas.

data.name: Unidentified hubdroid
data.death: During the attack on an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate
